integrity: Standalone exact verifier uses integral arborescence cofactors and exhaustive small circular words; no independent audit or validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Nonbinary enumeration for q>=3, n>=2 only; binary result and method have explicit prior coverage. The original 1982 binary source is not available in full, and undetected nonbinary equivalents remain possible. Finite checks support, but do not replace, the proof.
title: Exact two-window-defect enumeration of nonbinary de Bruijn necklaces
